title: eval-harness: improve per-prompt CI gating and metrics integration
author: Aisha Khan
body:
Motivation: The current eval-harness CI gate evaluates aggregate metrics which can hide per-prompt regressions. This change introduces per-prompt regression checks, improves metric collection in CI, and adds a basic rollback flag to avoid noisy failures for marginal regressions.

Summary of changes: - Add per-prompt gating logic and thresholds to the CI hooks so individual prompt sets can block merges when they regress beyond configured tolerances. - Integrate per-prompt metrics reporting into the CI pipeline (upload to internal metrics service and attach a summary artifact). - Add a lightweight feature flag to opt in/out of strict gating for experimental model rollouts. - Improve failure output: include top-k failing prompts, delta histograms, and links to the eval artifact.

Files touched include the eval harness CI glue (ci/eval_hooks.py), per-prompt configuration (eval/prompt_sets/config.yaml), a new metrics uploader (tools/ci/metrics_uploader.py), documentation updates, and a test harness for local runs.

Testing: - Ran the new CI job against multiple model snapshots (local sim and staging) and verified gating behavior for synthetic regressions. - Added unit tests to validate gating thresholds and artifact generation. - Verified metrics uploader resilient to transient network errors and includes retries.

Rollout: Default is opt-out for strict gating. Feature flag 'eval.per_prompt_strict_gate' is false by default. For high-trust repos we will flip the flag via repo config. We will monitor for two weeks on staging and roll to mainline repos afterwards.

Related: Linear ENG-2145, PM-98. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2145/per-prompt-gating-design (internal).
commits: add: per-prompt gating logic and thresholds (ci/eval_hooks.py)
feat: metrics uploader for CI artifacts (tools/ci/metrics_uploader.py)
chore: add prompt set config and defaults (eval/prompt_sets/config.yaml)
test: unit tests for gating and uploader (tests/ci/test_eval_gates.py)
docs: document per-prompt gating and rollout notes (docs/eval-harness/per_prompt_gating.md)
review_comments: Diego Ramirez: Can we avoid failing the entire merge on marginal deltas? Suggest adding a warning tier before blocking.
Aisha Khan: Added a two-tier gate (warning + hard block). warning tier logs and annotates PR; hard block is only for regressions > configured threshold. Default stays conservative.
Marcus Lee: The metrics uploader needs retries with exponential backoff to avoid flaky CI failures.
Aisha Khan: Implemented retries with jitter and updated tests to simulate transient failures.
Linh Tran: Please add a short example in the docs showing how to opt-in per repo and how to interpret the artifact.
Aisha Khan: Docs updated with example YAML and artifact breakdown.
Linh Tran: Approving after CI is green and tests cover edge cases. +1 from Marcus after small nits fixed.
merge_outcome: merged (squash) by Linh Tran after +2 approvals and green CI
release_notes: Enhances eval-harness CI with per-prompt gating and metrics integration. Adds per-prompt thresholds, improved failure artifacts, and a feature flag for conservative rollouts.
notes_for_sre: Monitor eval-ci job for increased runtime and artifact size. Metrics uploader errors should be surfaced to CI logs; alert if >5% upload failures in 24h.
changelog_entry: 2025-11-10: eval-harness: per-prompt CI gating and metrics uploader (A. Khan)
examples: To opt-in: add eval.per_prompt_strict_gate: true to repo eval config
